info.title: VDI & DaaS Configuration API
info.description: APIs to manage configurations in the VDI environment

tags.name: Machines
tags.description: Endpoints to manage and query machines

get.description: Retrieves a paginated list of machines with optional filtering, sorting, and search capabilities

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Field name to sort by. Valid fields: objectGuid, name, fqdn, netBiosName, siteId. Defaults to 'name' if invalid field provided.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: A case-insensitive search filter on the `fqdn` and `description` fields. If you enter multiple terms, such as `production server`, the endpoint returns all machines that contain 'production' in either of the searched fields AND 'server' in either of the searched fields. You can use double quotes to search for exact phrases (for example, `"production server"`).

parameters.name: folderPath
parameters.description: Filter machines by exact folder path match

parameters.name: site
parameters.description: Filter machines by monitor site name

parameters.name: outboundReady
parameters.description: If set to `true`, the endpoint only returns machines that are capable of establishing outbound connections from the machine to ControlUp's services.

parameters.name: includeDeleted
parameters.description: Include deleted machines in the results

parameters.name: includeDetails
parameters.description:
If set to true, the endpoint returns the following additional details:
* Agent: Port number and install mode
* LoadBalancing: Weight and preferred weight settings
* Management: Information about which extension added the machine via sync
* VdiStatus: Last outbound connection date and when the machine was missed in EUC

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of fields to include in the response. When specified, only these fields will be returned for each machine.

post.description:
Creates or updates machines in bulk. Identity is determined by FQDN computed as `computerName` or `computerName.domainName`.
When a machine already exists, only provided fields that differ from current values are applied; unspecified fields are left unchanged.

Note: If the ControlUp environment has the agent setting 'Deploy agents automatically (from monitor only)' enabled in the configuration console, adding a new machine (with isOutboundReady = false) via this endpoint will cause the ControlUp Monitor to attempt agent deployment to that machine automatically. This process runs from the Monitor service and requires valid domain credentials configured for the Monitor with local administrator rights on the target machines and necessary network/prerequisite access.

400.description: Bad request - Validation errors (unknown folderPath/siteName, duplicate FQDNs, or invalid payload)

delete.description: Deletes machines in bulk by FQDN.

400.description: Bad request - Validation errors or invalid payload

get.description: Retrieves detailed information for a specific machine by its unique identifier.

parameters.name: includeDetails
parameters.description:
If set to true, the endpoint returns the following additional details:
* Agent: Port number and install mode
* LoadBalancing: Weight and preferred weight settings
* Management: Information about which extension added the machine via sync
* VdiStatus: Last outbound connection date and when the machine was missed in EUC

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of fields to include in the response. When specified, only these fields will be returned.

fqdn.description: Fully qualified domain name of the machine to delete

ItemDeletionStatus.description: Result status of the deletion operation for a given item

domainName.description: Domain name the machine belongs to

folderPath.description: Target folder path; must exist when provided

siteName.description: Target monitor site name; must exist when provided

isOutboundReady.description: Enables outbound connectivity when true; clears when false/null

domainName.description: Domain name the machine belongs to

folderPath.description: Folder path in the organizational folder tree

siteName.description: Monitor site name where the machine is located

isDeleted.description: Indicates if the machine is marked as deleted

isOutboundReady.description: Indicates if the machine is ready for outbound connections

outboundReady.description: Indicates if the machine supports outbound connections

frameworkVersion.description: .NET Framework version installed on the machine

MachineAgentDataContract.description: Agent information for the machine. Returned only if `includeDetails` is set to `true`.

port.description: Port number the agent is listening on

installMode.description: Indicates if the agent is in install mode

MachineLoadBalancingDataContract.description: Load balancing configuration for the machine. Returned only if `includeDetails` is set to `true`.

enabled.description: Indicates if load balancing is enabled

MachineManagementDataContract.description: Management information for the machine. Returned only if `includeDetails` is set to `true`.

addedViaSyncByExtensionId.description: Extension ID that added this machine via built-in folder sync (supported from version 9.0)

MachineVdiStatusDataContract.description: VDI-specific status information. Returned only if `includeDetails` is set to `true`.

lastOutboundConnectionDate.description: Date and time of the last successful outbound connection

missedInEucSince.description: Date since when the machine has been missing in the EUC API

total.description: Total number of machines matching the query

field.description: Field name that caused the error

message.description: Specific error message for the field

BearerAuth.description: JWT token obtained from authentication service
